Class Executor<T>

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.am43.utils.Executor<T>
Type Parameters:
T - The type of the target object on which tasks operate.
public class Executor<T> extends Object
A thread-safe, single-threaded task executor that sequentially processes tasks asynchronously against a specific target object.
